jobs.title: Python Backend Developer Intern (FastAPI)
jobs.description:
Python Backend Developer Intern (FastAPI)




Location: Bangalore (On-site)

Company: Appscrip




About Appscrip




At Appscrip, we build products that solve real business problems using modern technologies like AI, cloud infrastructure, and scalable backend systems. We're looking for developers who enjoy building things, learning quickly, and aren't afraid to dive into new technologies.




If you've built projects in Python, experimented with FastAPI, or spent time playing around with AI and LLMs, we'd love to talk to you.




What You'll Be Working On




* Building and maintaining backend services using FastAPI.

* Developing REST APIs for web and mobile applications.

* Working with databases and designing efficient data models.

* Building features powered by AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

* Integrating third-party APIs and backend services.

* Debugging, optimizing, and improving existing systems.

* Collaborating closely with senior engineers to ship production-ready features.




What We're Looking For




* Strong Python programming skills.

* Hands-on experience with FastAPI through personal, college, internship, or freelance projects.

* Experience working with either PostgreSQL or MongoDB.

* Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and HTTP.

* Familiarity with Git and collaborative development.

* A genuine interest in AI and LLMs, with basic knowledge of concepts like:




* Prompt engineering

* Using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, etc.)

* RAG or AI agents (nice to know, not mandatory)

* Someone who's curious, enjoys solving problems, and likes learning new technologies.




Nice to Have




These aren't mandatory, but they'll definitely make your profile stand out:




* Redis

* Kafka or other messaging systems

* Docker

* Celery or background workers

* SQLAlchemy

* Vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)

* Experience deploying applications to the cloud




Who Can Apply?




* Final-year students

* Recent graduates

* Freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of experience




The most important thing for us is that you've built things. Whether they're college projects, hackathon submissions, personal projects, or open-source contributions—we'd love to see them.




Why Join Appscrip?




* Work on real production applications from day one.

* Get hands-on experience with modern AI technologies and LLM-powered products.

* Learn from experienced backend engineers.

* Exposure to scalable backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, and modern development practices.

* A fast-paced environment where you'll have ownership and plenty of opportunities to grow.




If you're passionate about Python, enjoy backend development, and are excited about building AI-powered applications, we'd love to hear from you.

 

If you are interested call us on none three one six one two zero one three one

jobs.title: Senior Backend Technical Lead - Python / FastAPI
jobs.job_title: Senior Backend Technical Lead - Python / FastAPI
jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW
Location: Bengaluru - full-time on-site at Four Seasons Private Residences, Embassy One, Hebbal (off Bellary Road).
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Backend Technical Lead to take daily technical ownership of our backend platform, APIs, database architecture and backend engineering quality.


This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a management-only position. You will lead backend implementation, review pull requests, work with AI coding agents, validate architecture decisions and make sure only production-quality code reaches protected development branches.


The focus is backend and platform engineering. You must also know React, Next.js and TypeScript well enough to review frontend/backend contracts and understand features end to end.


Role & responsibilities



Own backend engineering quality and technical standards.

Lead backend development in Python and FastAPI; participate directly in coding whenever required.

Design and review REST APIs; define and maintain OpenAPI specifications and Swagger documentation.

Review pull requests before merge, including reviewing and correcting AI-generated backend code.

Design and review PostgreSQL schemas, queries and migrations.

Enforce strict tenant isolation across the platform.

Design authentication and authorization systems; implement and review RBAC and permission models.

Design reliable integrations with third-party services.

Define asynchronous processing and background-job architecture; review Redis caching and distributed state strategies.

Ensure correct transaction handling, concurrency and idempotency; identify race conditions and data-consistency issues.

Improve automated testing and CI/CD quality gates; review backend and API security.

Review infrastructure-related backend decisions and diagnose complex production issues.

Mentor backend and junior developers; work closely with the Solution / Platform Architect and translate architecture decisions into production-ready implementations.


Preferred candidate profile
PYTHON / FASTAPI - STRONG EXPERTISE REQUIRED
Python 3.11+, FastAPI, async Python, Pydantic, REST APIs, OpenAPI, Swagger, API versioning, dependency injection, middleware, background processing, error handling, structured API responses, API security.


POSTGRESQL & DATA


PostgreSQL, SQL, database modelling, relational schema design, migrations, indexing, query optimisation, transactions, locking, concurrency, connection pooling, data integrity, replication concepts, backup and recovery. PostGIS, pgvector and PgBouncer are an advantage.


REDIS / BACKGROUND PROCESSING
Redis, caching strategies, distributed locks, background jobs, queues, scheduled jobs, retries, failure handling, idempotent processing. Celery or an equivalent distributed task system is strongly preferred.
AUTHENTICATION & SECURITY


OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC, IAM concepts, MFA concepts, session management, API authentication and authorization, tenant isolation, secrets management, secure API design. You must understand the security risks of multi-tenant SaaS platforms and distributed applications.


MULTI-TENANT ARCHITECTURE


Multi-tenant SaaS applications, tenant isolation, tenant-aware database queries, permission and authorization boundaries, preventing cross-tenant data leakage, scalable tenant architecture.


INFRASTRUCTURE & DEPLOYMENT


Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, Git, GitHub, GitHub pull-request workflows, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Terraform / Infrastructure as Code, Kamal deployment, AWS or equivalent cloud, compute infrastructure, load balancers, reverse proxies, networking fundamentals, S3-compatible object storage, CDN architecture, Cloudflare, environment and secrets management. You should understand high availability, zero-downtime deployments, rollback strategies, multi-region concepts, disaster recovery, horizontal scaling and production monitoring.


OBSERVABILITY & PRODUCTION OPERATIONS


Structured logging, application monitoring, metrics, tracing, alerting, health checks, production debugging, incident investigation, performance profiling.


FRONTEND KNOWLEDGE - REQUIRED BUT SECONDARY


Working knowledge of React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, frontend/backend API integration, authentication flows, server and client components, frontend state and data-fetching patterns. You do not need to be the primary frontend developer, but you must be able to review frontend/backend contracts and understand features end to end.


AI-ASSISTED ENGINEERING


AI is a core part of our engineering workflow. You should be comfortable with AI coding agents, AI-assisted development, reviewing AI-generated code, automated PR review, AI-generated tests, giving coding agents precise technical instructions, validating AI implementations rather than trusting them, correcting unsafe AI-generated code, and defining engineering rules that AI agents must follow. Strong engineering judgement matters more than experience with any specific AI product.


STRONG ADVANTAGE
Kubernetes, WebSockets, realtime systems, WebRTC, SIP, VoIP, FreeSWITCH, event-driven architecture, messaging systems, pgvector, PostGIS, Supabase, high-volume APIs, payment integrations, travel APIs, messaging platforms, AI / LLM integrations.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR A genuinely hands-on senior backend engineer who can lead technically. You should be able to open a pull request and spot incorrect tenant isolation, unsafe database transactions, race conditions, missing idempotency, poorly designed APIs, incorrect async logic, security vulnerabilities, inefficient SQL, poor database modelling, incorrect Redis usage, unnecessary coupling, missing tests, unsafe migrations, scaling bottlenecks, fragile deployment patterns and architecture that will become hard to maintain.


You should understand a feature end to end: React / Next.js -> REST API -> FastAPI -> business logic -> PostgreSQL / Redis -> infrastructure.


The role requires strong backend engineering judgement, ownership, technical leadership and the ability to keep a fast-moving AI-assisted development team technically disciplined.
